prompt: It is unfair to (say / speak) ill of a colleague behind their back.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «speak ill of someone» (плохо отзываться о ком-либо) используется глагол speak.

prompt: Scarcely had the coach (said / told) the athletes to warm up when the rain began pouring down.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует дополнения и инфинитива с частицей to: tell someone to do something.

prompt: “I'll call you right after we clear customs,” David (said / told) to his wife at the terminal.
explanation_ru: В прямой речи с предлогом to перед адресатом (said to his wife) используется глагол say.

prompt: Whenever the app freezes, customer support simply (says / tells) us to clear the cache.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «попросить/велеть кому-то сделать что-то» строится с помощью tell + дополнение + to-инфинитив.

prompt: Instead of exchanging tense emails, can we (say / talk) this issue through in person?
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «talk something through» (или talk something out) означает подробно обсудить проблему.

prompt: Broadly (saying / speaking), wool coats last longer than synthetic ones.
explanation_ru: В вводных конструкциях «broadly speaking» и «generally speaking» (вообще говоря) употребляется speaking.

prompt: The museum curator has already (said / told) the visitors twice where the audio guides are returned.
explanation_ru: После tell сразу идет прямое дополнение (the visitors), а затем придаточное с вопросительным словом where.

prompt: Please (say / speak) up so that the students in the last row can hear your presentation.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «speak up» означает «говорить громче».

prompt: Last month, my drama teacher (said / talked) me into auditioning for the lead role.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол «talk someone into doing something» означает уговорить кого-либо сделать что-то.

prompt: My nutritionist always (says / tells) that drinking enough water improves concentration.
explanation_ru: Когда не указан адресат речи сразу после глагола, перед придаточным с that используется say.

prompt: During dinner last night, my younger brother (said / talked) back to our dad about his curfew. Dad calmly (said / told) him that rude comments were unacceptable. Afterwards, my brother (said / told) sorry and cleared the table.
explanation_ru: «Talk back to someone» — дерзить; «tell someone that...» — сказать кому-то (с дополнением); «say sorry» — извиниться.

prompt: Mark regretted what he had (said / told) to his manager during the budget meeting. He asked to (say / speak) with her privately before lunch. She (said / told) him she appreciated his honesty.
explanation_ru: «Say something to someone» требует предлога to; «speak with someone» — поговорить с кем-то; «tell someone (that)...» — сказать кому-то без предлога.

prompt: The parking inspector has already (said / told) the motorist off for blocking the cycle lane. The driver tried to (say / talk) his way out of a fine, but the inspector (said / told) that the rules apply to everyone.
explanation_ru: «Tell someone off» — отчитать кого-либо; «talk one's way out of something» — выкрутиться с помощью уговоров; «say that...» используется без личного дополнения.

prompt: Why didn't you (say / tell) to the chef that the soup was cold? If you don't (say / speak) your mind, the kitchen won't know there is a problem. Next time, just (say / tell) the server right away.
explanation_ru: Перед предлогом to (to the chef) нужен глагол say; «speak one's mind» — прямо высказывать мнение; после tell сразу идет дополнение (the server).

prompt: It goes without (saying / telling) that guests must wear safety helmets in the workshop. Please (say / tell) the supervisor immediately if your strap is loose. Staff members (say / speak) both English and Spanish if you need assistance.
explanation_ru: «It goes without saying» — само собой разумеется; «tell someone» — сообщить кому-то; с названиями языков используется глагол speak.

prompt: In his message yesterday, the contractor (said / told) that the tiles would arrive on Friday. However, he didn't (say / tell) us what time the delivery van would get here. I will (say / talk) to him this afternoon to confirm the schedule.
explanation_ru: «Say that...» употребляется без адресата; «tell us what...» требует личного дополнения; «talk to someone» означает поговорить с кем-то.

prompt: Even during tense board meetings, Clara never hesitates to ___ her mind.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение «speak one's mind» означает открыто и прямо высказывать свое мнение.

prompt: Has anyone ___ the tenants on the third floor about tomorrow's water shut-off?
explanation_ru: Конструкция «сообщить кому-либо о чем-либо» без предлога перед адресатом строится с глаголом tell: tell someone about something.

prompt: Please don't ___ your little sister where we hid the chocolate cake.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу следует прямое дополнение (your little sister), за которым идет придаточное предложение с where.

prompt: “We cannot give your money back without a receipt,” the shop worker ___ as she returned the card.
explanation_ru: Для ввода прямой речи без указания адресата используется глагол say (said).

prompt: During the press conference, the director told very little to the journalists about his new film.
answer: During the press conference, the director said very little to the journalists about his new film.
accepted_answers: During the press conference, the director said very little to the journalists about his new film.
explanation_ru: Перед предлогом to с указанием адресата (to the journalists) и после прямого дополнения (very little) используется глагол say, а не tell.

prompt: Frankly speaking, I would prefer to stay in and read tonight.
answer: Frankly speaking, I would prefer to stay in and read tonight.
accepted_answers: Frankly speaking, I would prefer to stay in and read tonight.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: вводное выражение «Frankly speaking» (честно говоря) употреблено грамматически верно.

prompt: To say the truth, the local bakery makes much better bread than the supermarket.
answer: To tell the truth, the local bakery makes much better bread than the supermarket.
accepted_answers: To tell the truth, the local bakery makes much better bread than the supermarket.
To tell you the truth, the local bakery makes much better bread than the supermarket.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «по правде говоря» используется глагол tell: «To tell the truth».

prompt: You want to quote the exact warning your lab instructor gave the class on Monday. Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: “Wear protective goggles at all times near the burners,” the instructor spoke us on Monday.
“Wear protective goggles at all times near the burners,” the instructor said us on Monday.
“Wear protective goggles at all times near the burners,” the instructor told to us on Monday.
“Wear protective goggles at all times near the burners,” the instructor told us on Monday.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует прямого дополнения без предлога (told us), тогда как say требует предлога to (said to us).

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'tell' instead of 'say to': What exactly did the receptionist say to you when you checked in?
answer: What exactly did the receptionist tell you when you checked in?
accepted_answers: What exactly did the receptionist tell you when you checked in?
explanation_ru: Конструкция «say something to someone» заменяется на «tell someone something» без предлога to перед местоимением you.
